items.title: Execution branch at dev tip with row polish present
items.precondition: On kylie/notifications-ui-upgrade before or after execute
steps: Confirm branch contains NotificationRow, ProfileAvatar, NotificationSkeleton
Confirm no accidental backend diff in the PR
items.expected: Page has current dev row UX; scope is frontend-only.
items.evidence: 2026-08-02: kylie/notifications-ui-upgrade at dev tip; NotificationRow + ProfileAvatar + rowLinksToPost present; frontend-only diff.

items.title: Soft dashboard shell visible on /notifications
steps: Observe page background: soft gray canvas plate inside main
Confirm two stacked white cards: header (Bell + title) and list area
Confirm it does not look like a single flat feed-card page title stack
items.expected: Hero header card + separate list card on soft canvas; visually distinct from Feed.
items.evidence: 2026-08-02: User reviewed /notifications in session; soft canvas + header/list cards confirmed via screenshots.

items.title: Unread badge in header when notifications exist
items.precondition: At least one unread notification (or seed before visit marks read)
steps: Load /notifications before mark-read completes OR inspect initial paint
Confirm unread count pill appears in header card area
items.expected: Unread pill visible in header when unreadCount > 0 and not loading.
items.evidence: 2026-08-02: Header unread pill wired to unreadCount; user session showed unread rows before mark-read.

items.title: Row polish preserved
steps: Confirm avatars, type icons, relative timestamps, New chip on unread rows
Confirm friend request row shows Confirm / Decline
Trigger loading state (hard refresh) — skeleton rows appear
items.expected: Same row richness as pre-upgrade dev page.
items.evidence: 2026-08-02: User screenshots showed avatars, REPLY pill, timestamps, type icon column, shimmer skeletons in code.

items.title: Comment/reply row links to post without nested link bug
items.precondition: A comment-on-post or reply notification exists
steps: Click the row (not avatar) — navigates to post (and #comments when reply)
Click actor name/avatar on same row — profile link works; no invalid nested anchors
items.expected: Post navigation and profile links both work; preserves rowLinksToPost semantics.
items.evidence: 2026-08-02: rowLinksToPost preserved; flex row link fix applied during -c refinements.

items.title: Empty state on soft list card
steps: Observe empty state inside list card
items.expected: Bell empty state with 'You're all caught up' microcopy — not plain 'No new notifications'.
items.evidence: 2026-08-02: notifications-empty-state panel with Bell icon + caught-up copy implemented.

items.title: Dark mode intentional
steps: Inspect canvas, header card, list card, unread tints
items.expected: Readable contrast; no harsh white islands or invisible borders.
items.evidence: 2026-08-02: Token-driven CSS with .dark rules for canvas, cards, and shadows.
items.notes: Dark mode not separately screenshot in final session.

items.title: Other pages unchanged (plan 21)
steps: Confirm they still use title + feed-card stack without soft canvas
items.expected: No soft-page-canvas on Friends or Feed.
items.evidence: 2026-08-02: rg soft-page-canvas frontend/src/pages returns NotificationsPage only.
